questions.stem: In a group of 30 people, 18 play cricket, 15 play football and 8 play both. How many play neither?
questions.explain: At least one game: 18 + 15 − 8 = 25 people, since the 8 who play both were counted twice. So 30 − 25 = 5 play neither.

questions.stem: Which set equals the complement of A ∪ B?
questions.explain: Outside A ∪ B means outside A and outside B, so (A ∪ B)′ = A′ ∩ B′ (De Morgan).

questions.stem: If |A| = 4 and |B| = 5, how many ordered pairs are in A × B?
questions.explain: Each of the 4 elements of A pairs with each of the 5 elements of B, so there are 4 × 5 = 20 pairs.

questions.stem: If |A| = 7, |B| = 5 and |A ∩ B| = 2, what is |A ∪ B|?
questions.explain: Adding the sizes counts the overlap twice, so |A ∪ B| = 7 + 5 − 2 = 10.
